coordinator_note: Every theoretical value read against its quotes. Wang 2025 (multi-photon): Eq. 6 and Eq. 7 rest on a proof in Supplementary Note 2.2, which this file does not hold, so they stay LOW. Wang 2025 (diffusion): the query complexity theorems are stated by drawing on cited theorems with no separate proof; the Carleman sparsity is read off the explicit matrix and stays HIGH. Wang 2026 (robust training): every proposition and theorem graded HIGH is stated with its hypotheses and proved in Appendix A or D; the sign-clip approximation rests on a standard result the paper does not reprove, and the qRAM case is a specialization. Wang 2026 (Fourier symmetrization): every HIGH item is proved in Appendices A to E, the exponents read from the rendered pages. Wei 2021 (QCNN): only the Appendix A interior-pixel result is proved; the speedup is a claim that counts the convolution gates alone, and the O(n6) gate count is not explained
